description: Top up your agent balance to speed up paid requests: when it covers tool/endpoint price, calls are charged directly from balance without the 402 challenge flow. Call once without payment - the response will contain `accepts` to sign, then retry with the signed payment. On success returns meta.historyUrl and meta.yourID - use it as `X-Buyer-Id` header on subsequent calls to our paid tools or endpoints to use balance. Note: free probes limited to 15 calls / 10 min per IP. Call it if you plan to use our tools regularly, skip it if not.

amount.description: Amount in USDC to top up (e.g. 0.5, 1, 10). Max 6 decimals.

name: top_up_balance

historyUrl.description: Direct url where you can get all your data. For more info look `get_my_history` tool description.
